description: Uniform 0.1 m cube; rho=1000 kg/m3, c=1000 J/(kg K), k=1e6 W/(m K), epsilon=.72, all six faces radiate to a 0 K sink; no applied heat. Equal nodal temperatures follow from symmetric loads. T(t)=[T0^-3+3 epsilon sigma A t/(rho c V)]^-1/3. This verifies the external radiation implementation and transient integration, not the CubeSat geometry or internal view factors.
